title: Forward Deployed Computational Biologist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English Salary range: $128,000 - $150,000 Ideal start date: January or February 2027 About the role: We are seeking a Forward Deployed Computational Biologist to operate at the intersection of AI, software systems, and biology. In this role, you will work directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions for complex scientific problems as part of Owkin’s agentic platform, K Pro, to fully meet specific customer needs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will spend time at the customer’s premises, turning ambiguous scientific challenges—such as discovering novel drug targets or disease subtypes—into reliable and scalable agentic solutions. You will be responsible for both the scientific rigor of the analytical workflows and the technical robustness of their implementation and deployment, bridging the gap between science and real-world application. In particular, you will: Deploy & Custom-build : Tailor Owkin’s agentic AI platform, K Pro, to specific client needs by implementing new analytical workflows, and integrate our platform into the clients’ existing workflows. Solve Scientific Problems : Translate complex biological and operational questions into concrete computational workflows, utilizing deep clinical and multi-omics data (genomics, transcriptomics, etc.) and computational biology methodologies. Rapid Prototyping : Iterate quickly with users to validate solutions, balancing speed and quality to ensure effective, measurable impact. Collaboration : Work alongside Customer Success Managers, R&D data scientists, biologists, and software engineers to ensure the delivery of high-quality scientific insights. Knowledge Transfer : Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders—from clinicians and biologists to technical engineering teams—to ensure alignment and adoption. Participation in a team-wide on-call rotation is required. This role requires frequent international travel to support our global operations and client needs. Anticipated destinations include the Owkin Paris office as well as various client premises across the UK, US, France, Germany, and Switzerland. To facilitate this travel schedule, the successful candidate must be based in close proximity to a major international airport or major train station . About you Required qualifications / experience: Education : MSc/PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven expertise and impact in analyzing complex data, such as real-world clinical data and multimodal omics (e.g, bulk, spatial/single-cell, proteomics) and high-throughput experimental data. Biological knowledge : Strong knowledge of molecular biology and at least one major therapeutic area (oncology, Immunology & Inflammation, neurology, …). Bias for action : Ability to operate in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity, and driving progress toward delivery. Engineering Proficiency : Very strong programming skills in Python; ability to both ideate and conduct exploratory analyses and data visualisations to aid interpretation; and write clean, production-grade code. Strong familiarity with coding agents. AI/ML Experience : Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., cross-validation, statistical tests) and frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic AI frameworks is a plus. Communication : Exceptional ability to translate scientific complexity for non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Preferred qualifications/bonus: Experience in a Biotech/Pharma environment and excellent understanding of the different steps and respective needs of the typical Pharma drug discovery pipeline. Demonstrated ability to write production-level code in deployed products. #LI-MD1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability. Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information: Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn. The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information; Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format. If you think that you have been a victim of fraud, Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com contact the following authorities: [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/ [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

title: Research Associate II, Pluvinage Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking a Research Associate to join the Pluvinage Lab at the Arc Institute. Our goal is to improve the lives of patients with neurological diseases. We do this by exploring undiagnosed autoimmunity in rare mystery cases and common neurodegenerative conditions alike. Starting with clinical observations and primary patient tissue, we use functional genomics, protein display technologies, and computational tools to embark on deep mechanistic dives into the contribution of autoimmunity to cognitive function. Your work will have the potential to uncover novel autoantibodies that drive cognitive decline in autoimmune encephalitis, that modulate cognitive decline in dementia, and that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging.

The questions we ask:

  1. How do autoantibodies regulate cognition?
  2. What is the source, target, and mechanism of pathogenic autoantibodies in neurological disease?
  3. How can we eliminate pathogenic autoantibodies while leaving the rest of the immune system intact?
  4. How does comorbid autoimmunity contribute to cognitive decline in neurodegeneration?
  5. Are there protective autoantibodies that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging?

The approaches we take: discovery-driven projects starting with human samples (cerebrospinal fluid, PBMCs, brain tissue) from curated cohorts of patients with neurological diseases, CRISPR screens, phage display, immune repertoire sequencing.

In this role, you will work closely with senior lab members to drive high-throughput antibody discovery in autoimmune neurology and neurodegeneration. You will contribute across the full experimental workflow: designing constructs and libraries, cloning and validating reagents, executing screens across several protein display technologies, and analyzing and validating discoveries. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys both the precision of molecular biology and the challenge of making complex discovery workflows reproducible and scalable. Your work will help advance new diagnostic approaches from bench to bedside.

About you

  • You are detail-oriented and rigorous, taking pride in well-designed experiments, reliable reagents, and reproducible results.
  • You are curious and self-motivated, with a strong foundation in molecular biology and an eagerness to learn new protein display and antibody discovery technologies.
  • You enjoy working across an entire experimental workflow, from sequence design and cloning to screening and data analysis.
  • You are organized and able to manage multiple experiments while maintaining careful sample tracking and documentation.
  • You collaborate closely with others, communicate results and challenges openly, and troubleshoot thoughtfully.
  • You are passionate about translating discoveries into better diagnostics for patients with neurological disease.
  • This position is designed as a training role for individuals preparing to apply to a PhD program. The work associated with this role is expected to last approximately two years, giving you time to build a portfolio of research to support future applications.

In this position you will

  • Build Discovery Reagents: Work with senior lab members to design DNA constructs and protein display libraries; perform molecular cloning, sequence verification, and quality control of constructs and libraries.
  • Execute High-Throughput Screens: Prepare reagents and patient samples, carry out antibody discovery and antigen-identification workflows across multiple protein display platforms, and maintain rigorous controls and sample tracking throughout.
  • Analyze and Validate Discoveries: Process screening data using established analysis workflows, assess data quality and reproducibility, and work with senior lab members to prioritize hits and validate antibody–antigen interactions using complementary assays.
  • Develop and Optimize Workflows: Work with senior lab members to troubleshoot experiments, compare assay conditions, and help improve the sensitivity, specificity, throughput, and reproducibility of discovery methods.
  • Maintain Research Quality: Keep complete experimental records, document protocols and analysis steps, and maintain organized inventories of samples, constructs, libraries, and reagents.
  • Contribute to a Collaborative Lab: Communicate progress at lab meetings, coordinate experiments with senior lab members and collaborators, and contribute to shared lab operations, equipment maintenance, and protocol training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, immunology, genetics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an academic or industry setting (including independent lab work during your undergraduate studies).
  • Hands-on research experience in molecular biology
  • Demonstrated ability to execute multistep experimental protocols accurately, use appropriate controls, and maintain clear and complete laboratory records.
  • Growth mindset to stretch your scientific skillset in a supportive environment, and the awareness to know when to ask for help.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, including careful tracking of samples, reagents, and experimental conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently on established workflows and collaboratively with senior scientists.
  • Commitment to rigorous, reproducible research and a strong interest in antibody discovery and its diagnostic applications.

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Manager of Bioinformatics (Oncology Product Development)
description:
Natera is currently seeking a Bioinformatics Manager to join the Bioinformatics team focused on Oncology Product Development. In this role, the individual will manage a team of Bioinformaticians and Data Scientists and provide technical leadership in the design, development and validation of ctDNA-based diagnostic tests. This position requires extensive cross-functional collaboration with biostatistics, molecular biology, software engineering and commercial departments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioinformatics and data science, optimally with experience in the LDT assay development space, and an established record of project and technical leadership.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical leadership for product development projects by representing the bioinformatics team in cross-functional interactions and moving products through the full development process through validation and commercial launch.
  • Lead the effort to optimize workflows, improve tools and pressure test analysis pipelines for diagnostic tests, including the detection of cancer-associated variants and the implementation of evidence-based quality control thresholds.
  • Supervise bioinformatics scientists and data scientists, managing their technical contributions, prioritizing resources, and taking responsibility for their technical and professional development.
  • Provide input on experiment design, analysis and interpretation based on expert understanding of Natera’s technology and relevant mathematical principles.
  • Work at a high level of independence and responsibilities in carrying out assignments.
  • Contribute to our intellectual property portfolio.
  • Set standards for rigorous data analysis and lead the production of high-quality documentation. 

QUALIFICATIONS:

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (bioinformatics, engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, or similar).
  • Minimum of 4-8 years of post-graduate experience in a data science and/or bioinformatics role and 1-3 years of experience as technical lead in diagnostics or a related field
  • Experience moving algorithm-based products through commercialization and launch in a medical or biological application such as diagnostic testing, medical imaging, or biotechnology
  • 1-2 years of management experience leading a technical team with demonstrable evidence of leadership and team management skills.

Desirable, but not required:

  • Prior experience analyzing cancer-associated variant detection data

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience using Python or R for scientific data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling/machine learning, including probability theory and estimation/classification methods.
  • Experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data, preferably including algorithm development or optimization.
  • Proven ability to apply mathematical principles to solve real estimation problems and implement practical solutions.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills to independently make sound judgments and find creative solutions to moderately complex problems.
  • Experience leading technical projects, including defining and meeting project milestones, delegating tasks to more junior team members, and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$154,000—$192,500 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

2141 -  Data Scientist

Reporting to: Solution Architect

Role Summary and Impact :  

The Data Scientist reports to Solutions Architect and is responsible for designing, developing & deploying data modelling and automation solutions for a leading client across markets, the portfolio of brands. You should have a strong understanding of the concepts and tools in data enrichment, automation and agentic space. You focus on methodological depth and the correct application of data science techniques. You translate complex business questions into robust data models and automation workflows and work closely with engineers to bring these models into production in a scalable and maintainable way. You'll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters - for people and the planet, extending this impact directly to our client's strategic objectives.

What will you do :

  • Actively explore and identify the latest techniques related to DS, ML and automation/agentic techniques.
  • Perform hypothesis testing, data preparation and product prototyping based on modern statistical and DS/ML and agentic methods.
  • Research, develop and apply DS/ML/agentic models to solve business and clients’ problems effectively.
  • Use your knowledge to anticipate, identify, and address data issues related to redundancies, quality, and bias. Apply rigorous data cleaning and preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality data for modelling.
  • Lead data science projects, blending various data science techniques as needed to achieve optimal performance and actionable insights. Continuously explore innovative and novel approaches to improve modelling accuracy and efficiency.
  • Collaborate directly with internal analytics and business teams, to understand and document requirements, and deliver data science solutions that meet their specific business needs.
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and implement improvements to ensure data reliability.
  • Apply your communication, collaboration and emotional intelligence skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other teams and departments.

What you’ll need :

  • Proven experience in in applied data science, analytics, or ML engineering.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large-scale, multi-source data.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative coding workflows.
  • Advanced Python skills, incl. pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, scipy, statsmodels for modelling and analytics.
  • Bachelors or advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Math, or Sciences is preferred.
  • Experience in building and execution of advanced solutions for audience analytics and insights.
  • Strong analytic and problem-solving skills, understanding and experience in application of AI methodologies for data manipulation and insight. 
  • Experience with data visualization platforms beyond Power BI/Tableau.
  • Sufficient knowledge of data governance practices including data QA, general naming taxonomy, data & platform integration, etc. 
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders clearly and impactfully.

title: Associate Scientist III, Cardiac Modeling
description: The Opportunity insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. Our unique Virtual Human™ platform identifies novel, high-impact genetic intervention points, which our TherML™ platform translates into therapeutics—whether small molecules, biologics, or oligos. With multiple programs in metabolic disease and neuroscience advancing toward the clinic, and our first IND submission slated for the second half of this year, we are at a pivotal inflection point. We are seeking an Associate Scientist III to join our cardiac disease biology team. In this role, you will support the development and application of iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte (iPSC-CM) models to study the genetic and molecular underpinnings of cardiovascular disease — working at the intersection of human stem cell biology, cardiac physiology, and scalable experimental platforms to generate the datasets that fuel our ML-driven drug discovery efforts. You will design and execute experiments, optimize differentiation workflows, develop functional and scalable functional assays to connect cellular phenotypes to disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to Senior Scientist, Cardiometabolic Disease - Translational Genetics and requires you to be onsite at our South San Francisco office 5 days per week . Responsibilities iPSC-CM Platform & Model Development Differentiation & QC: Support the generation and maintenance of iPSC lines and their differentiation into cardiomyocytes in 2D format (monolayers), implementing rigorous quality control points at each stage of the pipeline and with emphasis on production scalability Genetic Disease Models: Assist in building isogenic iPSC-CM disease models — including patient and CRISPR-edited lines carrying disease-associated variants — and characterizing the cellular model to study cardiovascular pathophysiology Functional Assays & Disease Modeling Functional Readouts: Support the development and optimization of functional assays relevant to cardiovascular disease —contractility, electrophysiology, calcium handling, stress responses, high-content imaging — in formats compatible with high-throughput data acquisition Rigor & Reproducibility: Documentation including writing/reviewing technical procedures and SOPs, presentation of results in team meetings and maintaining laboratory notebook with scientific rigor Cross-functional Partnership Target Identification: Contribute to target identification and validation efforts by connecting cellular phenotypes to human genetic evidence, aligning around the team and company goals to advance drug discovery About You Experience & Qualifications Qualifications and previous experience: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in biology, biochemistry, or related discipline with at least 2 years of relevant experience in the biotech/biopharma industry Cell culture and iPSC-CM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in iPSC culture, cardiac directed differentiation and iPSC-CM model characterization in 2D (monolayer) format. Prior experience in 3D/engineered heart tissue platforms or organoids is a plus Genetic Disease Modeling: Previous experience developing genetic iPSC-CM disease models — patient-derived lines, CRISPR-edited isogenic pairs — to study cardiovascular mechanisms Cardiovascular Biology: Background in cardiomyocyte biology and/or cardiovascular disease is preferred Functional Assays: Experience with functional assays relevant to cardiomyocyte biology (contractility, calcium, electrophysiology, imaging, stress responses). Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world. 

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy Kids is looking for an early childhood educator and learning-content developer to build and strengthen learning activities and assessments for children in PreK through 2nd grade.

Working on a small, interdisciplinary team alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and academic experts, the Content Creator will identify gaps in our content library, create and revise learning experiences in English and Spanish, and improve the systems that support content development. Content spans bilingual (English and Spanish) learning activities and direct assessments across early literacy, language, math, and executive function.

We are looking for someone who understands how young children learn, is energized by using data to make content better, and cares deeply about making early learning both rigorous and fun. 

This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months.

Responsibilities:

  • Author high-quality, standards-aligned learning activities and assessment items in English and Spanish for PreK through 2nd grade, using subject-matter expertise and knowledge of early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK standards)
  • Map content coverage across the Khan Academy Kids library, building crosswalks that connect practice activities to assessments and identifying gaps in coverage
  • Revise and improve existing assessments based on direct child assessment data and psychometric analyses
  • Author and test new assessment items with children and educators in classroom settings
  • Learn and leverage Khan Academy Kids' content-authoring infrastructure, and partner with product and engineering to improve authoring tooling and workflows
  • Coordinate with creative teams on asset and audio requests, and improve audio-generation and quality-assurance processes
  • Serve as an editorial reviewer for new and existing content in both English and Spanish

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2+ years of experience developing educational content or teaching, ideally with children in preschool through second grade. Experience with early childhood assessment (item development, administration, or play-testing) is a strong plus.
  • Full professional fluency and strong writing and editing skills in English and Spanish, with mindfulness of dialectal variation in both languages. Must be able to create, edit, and adapt developmentally appropriate content while preserving meaning, tone, and cultural relevance across languages. Note that Spanish proficiency will be assessed during the hiring process.
  • Experience working with early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK frameworks) and ensuring alignment and coverage
  • Comfort using data and learner feedback to evaluate, prioritize, and improve content
  • Comfort learning technical systems and working with structured content, including experience with or a willingness to learn JSON and SQL
  • Experience collaborating with colleagues across product, engineering, design, research, creative, and academic teams
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with close attention to detail
  • Motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere."
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of other, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Ample paid time off as needed – Your well-being is a priority
  • 8 pre-scheduled Wellness Days in 2026 occurring on a Monday or a Friday for a 3-day weekend boost
  • Remote-first culture - that caters to your time zone, with open flexibility as needed, at times
  • Generous parental leave
  • An exceptional team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to do your best
  • The chance to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education
  • Opportunities to connect through affinity, ally, and social groups
  • And we offer all those other typical benefits as well: 401(k) + 4% matching & comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, and life

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

The compensation band for this role is $77,600 - $87,300 USD annually for candidates based in the United States and $104,862 - $117,969 CAD annually for candidates based in Canada.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data. 

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:  http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to restore cell health and resilience through cell rejuvenation to reverse disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life.

For more information, see our website at altoslabs.com.

Our Value

Our Single Altos Value: Everyone Owns Achieving Our Inspiring Mission.

Diversity at Altos

Altos Labs has been named one of the Top 3 Biotech Companies and ranked for the second year on the Forbes 2026 Best Startups in America list.  At Altos, exceptional scientists and industry leaders from around the world work together to advance a shared mission. Our intentional focus is on Belonging, so that all employees know that they are valued for their unique perspectives. We are all accountable for sustaining a diverse and inclusive environment.

What You Will Contribute To Altos

 

Join Altos Labs at the Bay Area Discovery Science center and play a pivotal role in our mission to reverse brain aging. We are seeking a driven neuroscientist with deep expertise in neurodegeneration to join our highly collaborative, fast-paced team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional experts to discover and validate optimal therapeutic targets for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. If you are passionate about translating complex biology into transformative therapies, we want you on our team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Science: Act as the scientific lead for a key segment of our neurodegeneration portfolio. You will shape critical research questions, design robust experiments, and drive studies through to actionable, interpretable conclusions.
  • Model Disease Biology: Design and execute in vivo studies using rodent models of neurodegeneration, strategically selecting models, timepoints, and endpoints tailored to specific biological questions and program stages.
  • Analyze Complex Tissue: Process and analyze both rodent and human brain tissue. This includes dissection, regional sampling, fixation, cryopreservation, sectioning, and comprehensive downstream characterization (molecular, biochemical, and histological).
  • Innovate Quantitative Readouts: Develop and apply precise quantitative readouts for pathology and disease biology, tracking markers such as protein aggregation, neuroinflammation, cell loss, and vascular integrity.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with internal experts—including in vivo pharmacology, histology, molecular biology, computational, and program management teams—as well as external collaborators and CROs to seamlessly deliver on shared timelines.
  • Champion Scientific Rigor: Establish and promote the highest technical and cultural standards across our scientific functions. You will help embed foundational practices—such as experimental rigor, blinding, randomization, data provenance, and reproducibility—into our day-to-day operations.
  • Drive Strategic Decisions: Actively contribute to program strategy and high-level decision-making, providing critical input on go/no-go recommendations. We value transparent communication, so you will be expected to flag risks early and candidly.
  • Ensure Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous, traceable records and structured data capture, ensuring your findings can be easily reviewed, reproduced, and built upon by the wider team.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep a close pulse on the latest neurodegeneration literature and proactively bring relevant external developments to bear on our internal research programs.

Who You Are 

The level of the position will depend on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

Core Expertise & Credentials

  • Neurodegeneration Specialist: You hold a Ph.D. in Neuroscience (or a related field) backed by 1+ years of post-doctoral or industry research experience focused on neurodegeneration.
  • Disease Biology Deep-Dive: You bring a robust understanding of neurodegenerative disease biology, including a nuanced perspective on the strengths and limitations of the rodent models used to study it.
  • Proven Track Record: You have an established publication record in the field and are accustomed to presenting your findings at conferences or similar scientific venues.

Technical & Experimental Capabilities

  • Hands-on Analyst: You have extensive, practical experience processing and analyzing both rodent and human brain tissue samples.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Therapeutic Fluency: You have experience working with therapeutic modalities relevant to the Central Nervous System (CNS), such as AAV-based approaches, ASOs, or small molecules.
  • Data-Driven Design: You possess strong quantitative and statistical judgment, enabling you to design appropriately powered studies, analyze complex data, and interpret results objectively without over-extrapolating.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.

Scientific Mindset & Adaptability

  • Fiercely Independent & Rigorous: You are highly self-directed—capable of defining a problem, selecting the right approach, and driving it to a conclusion with minimal oversight. You practice rigorous critical thinking and are always willing to interrogate your own data or change your position when the evidence warrants it.
  • Thrive in Dynamic Environments: You are comfortable and composed in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can shift, decisions carry real weight, and quality must be sustained under pressure.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: You excel at working across disciplines and possess the strong communication skills needed to present complex technical datasets clearly to broad, mixed audiences.
  • Standard Bearer: You are enthusiastic about defining, implementing, and championing technical and cultural standards (like experimental rigor and reproducibility) across our scientific functions.

Preferred Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Omics Interest: You have some exposure to analyzing biological datasets and a strong desire to build deep expertise in transcriptomics, proteomics, or spatial approaches.
  • Technical Foundations: You possess basic skills in bioinformatics data processing or programming (e.g., Python or R) and are eager to apply these to large-scale data management.
  • Human Cohort Awareness: You are interested in expanding your knowledge of working with human post-mortem or biopsy samples and the unique challenges of cohort-level data.
  • Technique Expansion: You are motivated to learn advanced imaging techniques, spatial biology, or high-content quantitative histology to enhance your research.
  • Collaborative Teamwork: You demonstrate strong potential for growth and a commitment to working effectively within a high-performing, collaborative team environment.
  • Clear Communicator: You are a clear and effective communicator, capable of presenting technical information to your peers and cross-functional partners.

title: Warehouse Operator
description:
ABOUT SINGULAR GENOMICS

Singular Genomics is inventing at the forefront of genomics, one of the world’s fastest-growing industries. The commercially available G4® Sequencing Platform is a powerful, highly versatile benchtop genomic sequencer designed to produce fast and accurate results. In addition, the company is currently developing the G4X™ Spatial Sequencer, an upgrade to the G4, which will leverage Singular’s proprietary sequencing technology, applying it as an in situ readout for transcriptomics, proteomics and fluorescent H&E in tissue, with spatial context. Singular Genomics’ mission is to empower researchers and clinicians to advance science and medicine.

We foster a culture of creativity and technical excellence, both catalysts for innovation. We celebrate diversity, emphasize collaboration and, as we rapidly mature, we are constantly looking at ways we can do better for our people.

Our Headquarters are located on the Torrey Pines Mesa, in La Jolla, California at the center of the biotech hub. Our Manufacturing facility is in Sorrento Valley.

 

Position Summary:

As an Warehouse Operator, you will be a vital member of the Supply Chain team, directly supporting instrument and consumables manufacturing operations. In this role, you serve as a primary owner of inventory accuracy, data integrity within NetSuite ERP, and material traceability.

Beyond daily cycle counting and inventory control, you will actively manage inter-site material transfers using company vehicles, support shipping/receiving operations, manage non-inventory purchasing logistics, generate assembly Work Orders, and drive strategic warehouse space optimization. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Warehousing, Planning, Procurement, and Finance to safeguard inventory precision, prevent supply disruptions, maintain a high standard of safety, and support continuous process improvements. This position is onsite, 8am-4:30pm first shift, and reports to the Manager, Supply Chain

Responsibilities:

  • Receiving & Inbound Material Handling
    • Unload incoming freight, truckloads, and container shipments safely and efficiently.
    • Inspect inbound goods against packing slips, purchase orders, and specifications to verify quantities and check for visible damage.
    • Execute system receipts and log incoming inventory accurately into the ERP system (NetSuite).
    • Stage, tag, and route received materials to appropriate stock locations, inspection areas, or production lines.
  • Order Fulfillment, Picking, & Packing
    • Review picking lists and select items accurately using standard operating procedures and RF scanners or barcode software.
    • Pick, pack, and label customer orders, kits, or internal requisitions with high attention to detail to prevent errors.
    • Stage finished shipments in designated loading zones and assist with safe loading into outbound transport vehicles.
  • Inventory Control, Site-to-Site Transfers, & Truck Runs
    • Execute systematic site-to-site inventory transfers, ensuring materials are accurately picked, staged, documented, and transacted between facilities or internal locations.
    • Conduct routine truck runs between company sites to safely deliver inventory, parts, supplies, and miscellaneous items according to scheduled routes.
    • Perform cycle counts, physical inventory counts, and location audits to maintain high stock accuracy.
    • Adhere to First Expired or FIFO stock rotation principles, monitoring lot tracking and expiration dates where applicable.
    • Process material adjustments, scrap/non-conformance disposition movements, and other inventory transactions within the system.
  • Safety, Housekeeping, & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free workspace by applying 5S methodology (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain).
    • Operate material handling equipment (such as pallet jacks, hand trucks, and forklifts if certified) safely and inspect equipment prior to use.

    • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and operational reviews to streamline floor workflows.

  • Prior experience with RF-Smart and asset management systems a plus
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift heavy materials (frequently up to 50 lbs) throughout a standard shift.
  • Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Certifications: Forklift certification or willingness to obtain one is a plus.

description:
Company info

NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan. We’re developing medicines to treat aging by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore youthful function in aged cells. We’ve built the world’s leading experimental and artificial intelligence system to discover reprogramming medicines at massive scale. Our first products are focused on restoring youthful metabolic, endothelial, and immune function.

Description

NewLimit is seeking a Scientist to design, formulate and characterize targeted LNPs (tLNPs) with antibody conjugates, Nanobodies, and scFv’s to build our targeting LNP platform with a particular focus on getting nucleic acid payloads into target cells and tissues beyond the liver.

This is a hands-on bench role with targeting compositional and reaction design ownership. You will work closely with the Delivery Sciences and biology teams to design and build relevant targeting lipids portfolio for New Limit’s pipeline programs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop LNP compositions and conjugation chemistries for antibodies, nanobodies, scFv’s, peptides, and other targeting moieties across multiple structural families, pushing the platform beyond current-generation materials for extra-hepatic targeting.
  • Plan conjugation reactions and purification for these modalities with scale and final purity in mind from the outset, delivering against agreed project timelines.
  • Test targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle.
  • Develop conjugation chemistries in-house or work with external partners to get the targeted LNPs for a particular target cell and build processes to support research teams to test the tLNPs in vivo.
  • Turn in vitro and in vivo data from discovery teams into concrete structural hypotheses and optimize the tLNP compositions or the type of targeting molecules used.
  • Present experimental results, and SAR conclusions, authoring protocols and technical reports.

Requirements

  • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Biochemistry or a related discipline, plus 1–2 years of relevant work; or an MS with 5 years of focused tLNP design experience for liposomal or lipid nanoparticle applications.
  • Strong skill set in the design formulation of new targeted LNPs, performed personally rather than with a supervisor directing each step.
  • SAR-driven design, purification, and characterization of tLNPs and targeted moiety conjugated lipids and AI-based SAR prediction tools for tLNP applications.
  • Working knowledge of conjugation chemistries for attaching targeting moieties such as peptides, antibodies, nanobodies, and small-molecule ligands, including linker design and the selection of suitable biorthogonal or site-specific handles.
  • Practical purification skills spanning normal- and reverse-phase, size-exclusion chromatography and preparative HPLC.
  • Analytical characterization across LC-CAD, LC-UV, DLS, CE, bio-layer interferometry and surface plasmon resonance with the ability to deconvolute the data to produce well-characterized tLNPs.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with novel conjugation chemistries and reaction methods.
  • Targeting moiety optimization experience for Immune cells and endothelial cells.
  • Exposure to scale-up process development, CMC, or tech transfer to a CDMO.
  • Experience with data visualization and statistical analysis (R, Python, JMP)

Benefits

NewLimit provides generous benefits so our team can remain focused on our mission:

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Industry-leading PTO: 20 days per year plus holidays.
  • On-site meals and snacks.

Salary Range: $130,000 to $171,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. title: Associate Video Producer
description: Y Combinator is the leading startup accelerator for entrepreneurs. Since 2005, YC has invested in over 6,000 companies, including Airbnb, Dropbox, OpenAI, Stripe, Reddit, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Instacart. Today, YC has built the most powerful startup community in the world and is committed to supporting founders for the life of their company. Job Description: Y Combinator is looking for an Associate Video Producer to join the YC Media team. This is a role for someone who is smart, organized, resourceful, and already immersed in startups and technology. You’ll work closely with our Senior Video Producers across videos, podcasts, interviews, and other editorial projects. You’ll help with everything from research and pre-interviews to editing, publishing, scheduling, guest communication, and keeping our production calendar on track. A lot of this job is making sure things actually get finished. You should be the kind of person who notices what needs to happen next, follows up without being asked, and is happy moving between creative work and the less glamorous details that keep a production running smoothly. Just as importantly, you should understand the world YC operates in. You follow startups, AI, technology, and the people building them. You know what people in this world are talking about, can quickly understand why something matters, and have enough context to ask good questions rather than starting from zero every time. What you'll do: Help produce YC videos and podcasts Work with Senior Video Producers to move projects from idea to shoot to final publication. Research guests, companies, technologies, and topics. Help write interview questions, briefs, descriptions, and other editorial material. Schedule and conduct pre-interviews, take detailed notes, and report back to producers. Coordinate shoot dates and logistics with founders, companies, and guests. Review edits and help prepare projects for final approval. Edit short-form clips and other video content. Keep productions organized Maintain notes and project documentation throughout the production process. Keep project cards, production schedules, shoot calendars, and publishing calendars up to date. Track where every project is in the pipeline and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Manage transcripts, video files, review links, and other production assets. Download and organize final videos and other assets in Dropbox. Transcribe finished recordings. Send final edits, transcripts, file links, and YouTube links to YC partners and other collaborators. Help publish and distribute our work Upload and publish episodes across YouTube, podcast platforms, and other channels. Make sure titles, descriptions, thumbnails, transcripts, chapters, and other publishing assets are ready. Help coordinate the final steps between editorial, production, and distribution. Help things run smoothly on shoot days Welcome guests and help get them where they need to be. Make sure guests have water, food, and anything else they need. Help keep sets clean, reset, and ready for the next shoot. Occasionally assist as a camera operator. Help keep our production gear and equipment organized. You might be a good fit if: You’re deeply interested in startups, AI, technology, and the internet, and already understand YC and startup culture. You know the companies, people, ideas, and conversations that matter in this world. You’re intellectually curious and learn quickly. You can get up to speed on an unfamiliar company or technical subject without needing everything explained to you. You have some experience producing or editing video, podcasts, or other media. You’re a strong writer and researcher with good editorial instincts. You can recognize what’s actually interesting about a person, company, or idea and explain complicated technical topics clearly. You’re extremely organized, reliable, and comfortable managing lots of small details across several projects at once. You communicate clearly and follow up quickly. You’re willing to do whatever needs to be done to make a production successful, whether that’s editing a clip, researching a guest, updating a calendar, or grabbing lunch for a shoot. You have strong attention to detail. A wrong link, missing file, forgotten follow-up, or stale calendar entry bothers you. You should be able to spot the difference between Arial and Helvetica or know if it's a Dutch or French flag. You have some hands-on experience with cameras, audio, and video production equipment. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable helping set up and operate gear on shoots. You’re able to safely lift up to 50 pounds as needed for production gear and shoot setup. This is a good role for someone early in their media career who wants to learn the entire production process rather than specialize in one narrow part of it. You might currently be an assistant producer, production assistant, video editor, podcast producer, editorial assistant, or someone who has been making your own projects and wants to do this professionally. We're less interested in a particular resume than whether you're sharp, curious, capable, and genuinely plugged into the world we cover. The best person for this role will be equally comfortable thinking about what makes a piece of content good and doing the hundred small things required to actually get it published. Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. Some projects may also require travel and weekend work. Compensation : $180,000-$200,000 salary (depending on skills and experience). Benefits : Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, an infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, a flexible spending account, a health savings account, a 401(k) with 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and a flexible paid time off policy. Work Authorization: This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship. Y Combinator considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance. Y Combinator is committed to protecting the privacy of job applicants' personal information and to complying with the California Consumer Privacy Act. The privacy policy of Ashby, Inc., the hiring platform used by Y Combinator, governs the collection of such data and is available here .

title: 21GRAMS- Project Coordinator
location: Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; Remote - USA
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Coordinator to join our growing team!  

 

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human.  Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you? 

 

The Project Coordinator is an entry-level role that supports the project management team in the delivery of integrated healthcare communications. This role builds core skills in scheduling, routing, documentation, and agency systems, and serves as the foundation for growth within the project management career path.

 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

 

What you’ll do: 

• Support Project Managers with day-to-day task execution across multiple projects and brands.

• Maintain timelines, hot sheets, status reports, and project documentation with version control.

• Route deliverables through internal departments and track review cycles, including MLR and PRC submissions and returns.

• Assist in meeting preparation, capture detailed notes, distribute action items, and follow through on next steps.

• Open job codes, set up folders and Teams channels, and keep filing structures organized.

• Prepare small estimate requests and coordinate simple vendor engagements under guidance.

• Escalate risks, blockers, or quality issues to the project lead quickly and clearly.

 

Portfolio Management:

• Project-focused. No revenue oversight. No new business involvement.

Resource Management:

• No ownership of resourcing data or personnel communications.

• No Gantt ownership. Shadow staffing conversations to learn expectations.

Client and Vendor Relationship Management:

• Observer on client calls and email communications.

• Observer on vendor communications.

Training, Growth, Reporting:

• Establish professional attitude, self-motivation, and organization.

• Learn department onboarding checklists and reference documents.

Admin Operations:

• Learn Workfront routing, OpenAir and PowerBI basics, and timesheet review steps.

• Support day-to-day routing and traffic of jobs.

Execution:

• Update hot sheets and timelines. Send meeting notes and recaps.

• Learn project lifecycle and ask clarifying questions to build knowledge.

Finance:

• Open job codes. Pull basic reports for hours and OOPs.

• Create small-scale estimates for simple tactics under supervision.

Culture, Comms and Collaboration:

• Maintain a positive, can-do attitude and team mindset.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 

What you should have:  

• Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, marketing, or related field preferred.

• Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365. Familiarity with Workfront and Teams is a plus.

• 0 to 2 years in marketing or agency environments including internships.

• Demonstrated interest in healthcare communications and project management.

title: Supervisor, Reagent Manufacturing - 2nd Shift
description:
At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness.

We are looking for a dynamic, driven, and passionate Manufacturing Supervisor to build, grow, and run a manufacturing team in a fast-paced and fun environment. We need an individual comfortable developing an organization and processes to support the unique needs of the genomics industry. We are building a fully integrated Operations team to work closely with our technology and product development teams to empower the scientific community and accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We look for flexible candidates eager to build an amazing company and launch amazing products!

Our Reagent Manufacturing Supervisor will be leading a team of full-time and contractor technicians responsible for production execution across the entire Reagent Manufacturing value stream.

This role will report to our Manager, Reagent Manufacturing and will be a 2nd Shift San Diego based role.

If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • As a PEOPLE LEADER: Professional and servant leader who removes roadblocks from the team, motivates them to victory, and supports their professional development
  • As a SUPERVISOR: A team player when it comes to solving problems and achieving production goals
  • As a CONTRIBUTOR: An innovative and proactive problem solver and can be fully entrusted to deliver exceptional results on any project, task, or duty
  • Directs manufacturing leads and team members to ensure day-to-day production goals and schedule commitments are met
  • Accountable for the shift's key performance indicators and the team's completion of the daily production schedule; ensures the team meets or exceeds manager expectations
  • Establishes production schedules and priorities with manager oversight and ensures execution of the schedule is efficient and optimized
  • Contributes to technology transfer and new product introduction as the voice of Manufacturing. Responsible for successful pilot/development runs and consults the manager on decisions impacting the broader team
  • Partners with Process Engineering and other support groups to enable troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Focuses on resource management, impact analysis, and improvements to safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput
  • Collaborates with the Quality team to maintain adherence to quality systems, procedures, operating standards, and applicable compliance requirements
  • Partners with the Manager and Human Resources on hiring, performance, promotion, and termination decisions. Provides major input on FTE decisions, is responsible for contractor hiring, and executes the approved hiring plan
  • Accountable and responsible for the team's training program, including on-time completion of training assignments, accurate training plans, a robust OJT program, and appropriate ad-hoc, awareness, and remedial training
  • Responsible for tactical coaching and development of team members and contributes to strategic team development in consultation with the manager. Provides leadership to a diverse workforce and supports ancillary production activities as needed
  • Ensures team adherence to the Employee Handbook, company policies, environmental health and safety requirements, and safe work practices across formulating, filling, and kitting operations
  • Key contributor to ECO/DCO/NCR documentation. Authors selected technical documentation, owns area-specific WI/BR/SOP redlines, and contributes to higher-level Manufacturing documentation

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelors in science, engineering, or a related discipline is preferred with 2+ years of relevant manufacturing/engineering experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or diagnostic manufacturing
    • An equivalent combination of experience and education, including a high school diploma plus equivalent progressive experience, may be considered
  • Prior experience leading or supervising manufacturing personnel is required
  • Relevant experience in the life science industry is preferred
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 is preferred
  • Advanced understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles and Six Sigma methodologies; Green Belt training
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; able to lead shift start-up/Tier I meetings and small-to-medium meetings
  • Proficiency in people skills with sufficient emotional intelligence; collaborates effectively across teams and delivers tactful constructive feedback to direct reports
  • Demonstrated competency in critical thinking and problem solving, including outside-the-box problem solving
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel, and manufacturing/workplace systems such as Jira, Confluence, 42Q, Arena, NetSuite, ERP, QMS, or similar platforms
  • Understanding of key manufacturing processes and technical elements, including basic DNA and sequencing principles, sufficient to enable effective troubleshooting and provide feedback on minor ECOs/DCOs
  • Ability to perform descriptive data analysis using basic and intermediate statistical techniques and apply insights to root-cause analysis, process improvement, communication, and business decisions
  • Basic understanding of the wider business context, manufacturing finance, and ISO 13485 requirements
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and technically challenging environment with strong ownership and mostly autonomous execution of day-to-day responsibilities
  • Strong inclination toward continuous improvement, talent development, and building a collaborative, high-performing team

Physical Requirements:

  • This is a Second Shift position – 2pm – 10:30pm PST, Monday-Friday
  • Ability to lift up to 20 pounds
  • The position requires physical activity and the handling of chemicals. Candidates are required to follow the safety protocols and be familiar with personal protective equipment (PPE) while working in the laboratory environment

Location:

  • San Diego – on-site

Travel: 

  • N/A

Job Type:

  • Full-time, Exempt

Base Compensation Pay Range:

  • $102,000 - $125,000



 

In addition to base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, discretionary annual bonus, no cost health insurance plans, 401k with company match, and flexible paid time off. 

 

Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience. 

 

We foster an environment such that all people are afforded the freedom to pursue their passions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.
