title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist II
description:
Location: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

Shift: Tuesday - Saturday, 11:30am-8:00pm

About our Company:

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

About the Role

The Clinical Laboratory Scientist II will be responsible for performing a variety of laboratory procedures involved in end-to-end processing of biological samples to enable successful downstream next-generation sequencing (NGS). Processing will include accessioning and both manual and automated extraction, library preparation, hybrid capture, sequencing and QC steps. Under the guidance of the Director of Clinical Laboratory Operations and the Laboratory Director, you will work collaboratively within the clinical laboratory leveraging your technical knowledge, skills and abilities to ensure efficient and quality results are provided to our clients and patients while also informing/participating in process improvements. This position will report to the Lab Manager.

 

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology from an accredited institution

    • Education received at a college or university located outside of the United States or United States Territories requires a credentials equivalency evaluation by an approved agency

  • Hold a current and active American Society of Clinical Pathology (ASCP) board certification

  • Hold current and valid Clinical Laboratory Scientist licensure (Generalist or CGMBS)

  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of the general biological principles that govern DNA biology

  • Possess a strong foundational understanding of common molecular biology techniques, such as PCR/qPCR, DNA ligation, and DNA extraction

  • Working level knowledge or ability to learn use of common molecular biology instruments; Agilent Tapestation/capillary electrophoresis, Qubit, plate readers, thermocyclers and other common laboratory instruments

  • Previous experience handling human biological materials is required

  • Working knowledge of how to safely operate in a BSL-2 environment is required

  • Previous experience handling, processing, and extracting DNA from biological specimens is required

 

What You Will Do

Technical

  • Perform routine and complex diagnostic laboratory testing on patient samples for clinical, biopharma, and academic partnerships.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight to non-licensed personnel for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical activities.

  • Interpret data and results of all analyses according to set procedures and guidelines.

  • Support day to day operations by assisting with data entry, receiving samples and consumables, reagent preparation, sample preparation, temperature recording, laboratory maintenance and documentation.

  • Identify and resolve problems that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results following the escalation path to clinical leadership as needed.

  • Assist with research, translational research, regulated products through the execution of partnership studies and internal/external validation studies.

  • Participate as a contributing member of the clinical laboratory by assisting in routine activities, to include but not limited to general upkeep and stocking, SOP author and review, and continuous improvement.

  • Proposes assay and process improvements and conducts improvement activities under guidance.

  • Demonstrate forward thinking and initiative in work planning and execution of work in order to achieve on-time report delivery.

  • Participate in new or revised assay launches giving input on launch logistics as appropriate.

  • Participate in work planning initiatives and scheduling.

Quality, Training & Equipment

  • Maintaining documentation in compliance with Good Laboratory Practices and Quality Systems.

  • Assist with quality control and quality assurance activities. Responsible for reviewing and analyzing the health of laboratory quality metrics in collaboration with clinical leadership.

  • Complete initial training and maintain competencies as current and up to date for all trained assays.

  • Wear appropriate PPE as required and comply with safety rules and regulations.

  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP).

  • Participate in IQ/OQ/PQ for equipment to ensure ability to train team members on proper use and maintenance as appropriate.

  • Escalate equipment issues that impact TAT or patient safety.

  • Assist, perform, and review instrument correlation studies. Collaborate with operational leadership on equipment analysis for assay expansion or improvement.

  • Perform instrument and procedural calibrations and maintenance.

  • Advises and drives progress on troubleshooting equipment issues.

  • Adhere to the laboratory's quality control policies including document control activities, change management, corrective preventative action.

  • May act as trainer in place of designated trainer/training team.

Team

  • Cultivate, build and maintain positive and collaborative relationships within teams and cross-functionally.

  • Operate as a thought leader and hold cross-functional teams accountable to regulatory, quality, scientific and performance standards to ensure the highest quality for sample integrity.

  • Seen as a role model for safety behavior standards and cultural tenets.

  • Serves as a leader from the bench, demonstrating consistency in good lab practices.

 

Working Conditions and Physical Effort

Staff in this role must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation. Certain physical activities may be required in order to perform the essential functions of this job. Examples of these requirements include but are not limited to the following:

 

 

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus
  • Long-term equity awards
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays
  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$47.19 - $58.99  

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

title: Scientist II, Screening
description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

The Role

Profluent is seeking a motivated, rigorous, and collaborative scientist to establish and lead a centralized gene editor screening function. High-quality experimental data is a core input to our protein design models, and this role will own the screening operations that produce it.

This role centers on building and running a screening core responsible for assay standardization, data quality, and team development. At first, you will support campaigns that generate training and evaluation data for our protein design models, and the scope may grow to cover more programs. You will design, run, and troubleshoot mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats. You will set the technical standards that make our data reproducible and trustworthy. You will also build and mentor a team of Research Associates, and coordinate closely with Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology to keep the screening pipeline running smoothly from start to finish.

As a leader of the team, you will balance hands-on scientific execution with people management and process development. You will identify, prioritize, and drive infrastructure projects that improve throughput, consistency, and assay sensitivity. You will also work with leadership to shape the long-term scope of the core.

We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who share our commitment to revolutionizing biology, driving meaningful innovation, and making a lasting impact on global healthcare.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven protein design while collaborating with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team of experts in machine learning, protein engineering, cell biology, and gene editing.

 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a team of 2–4 Research Associates, including hiring, training, performance management, and career development
  • Train and mentor staff on aseptic technique, assay execution, and documentation standards
  • Foster a supportive team culture that prioritizes growth, engagement, and well-being

Execution

  • Prioritize, schedule, and resource cross-functional experiments in coordination with Automation and Bioinformatics
  • Design, execute, troubleshoot, and analyze mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats
  • Onboard new assays and extend existing assays to new enzyme classes
  • Maintain sample chain of custody from plate mapping through automation, sample preparation, and sequencing submission, partnering with Bioinformatics on data schema and capture
  • Communicate technical results clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences
  • Deliver QC'd, analysis-ready datasets with documented QC flags to ML

Process Development

  • Define and enforce technical standards, and write and maintain SOPs
  • Qualify new assays and define acceptance criteria based on reproducibility data
  • Maintain cell line quality and inventory for screening assays, in coordination with teams that manage cell banks
  • Characterize assay sensitivity, including the minimum detectable difference in activity at standard replicate counts
  • Identify, prioritize, and plan infrastructure projects that continually improve assays and processes
  • Coordinate process development across Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology
  • Evaluate the costs and benefits of centralizing high-throughput workflows in partnership with other teams
  • Work with leadership to assess and refine the scope of core functions

 

Qualifications

  • PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or MS in a related field and 10+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience with bacterial and mammalian cell culture, genome editing, and NGS-based assays
  • Experience with high-throughput experimentation and analysis of large datasets
  • Experience with LIMS or ELN systems for sample and experiment tracking
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards and drive consistent execution across operators


Preferences

  • Experience working in or building a core facility or centralized service function
  • Track record of building or improving high-throughput processes
  • Experience leading infrastructure or process improvement projects

description:
The Role: 

Generate’s Prototyping Lab builds the experimental systems that let us measure protein function at unprecedented scale. By combining synthetic biology, large DNA libraries, high-throughput assays, and machine learning, the team creates workflows that turn complex biological questions into rich, usable datasets. 

We’re looking for two Scientists with a strong record in experimental synthetic biology to develop pooled screens capable of testing hundreds of thousands of protein variants in parallel to identify protein binders and modulators. You’ll shape these experiments via DNA library design, pooled in vitro protein display, and NGS-based enrichment analysis. For one of the two roles, we are looking for a Scientist who additionally has experience in mammalian cell engineering and membrane protein studies. Experience in computational modeling or statistical analysis would help you connect experimental design to the quality and usefulness of the resulting data. 

You’ll work closely with Protein Sciences and Machine Learning teams to build screening approaches that deliver clear, quantitative insight into protein function. The role offers substantial scope to originate and advance new technologies, with close collaboration across a well-resourced biotech team.

Here's how you will contribute:

  • Build pooled screening workflows to achieve scalable protein binding and functional readouts, from assay setup through data interpretation.
  • Collaboratively establish reliable assay conditions, quantitative measures, and handoff plans that enable project teams to maximize platform utility.
  • Identify opportunities to test unconventional hypotheses, applying the strongest concepts for drug program acceleration and supporting IP filings.  
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations, and present them in presentations and in writing to colleagues across disciplines.
  • Use quantitative reasoning, modeling, and critical literature review to inform experimental choices. 

The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • PhD in synthetic or systems biology, bioengineering or a related field with 0-1 year of experience; alternatively, a bachelor’s or master’s degree with at least 6 years of highly relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing and running pooled binding screens, ideally using both purified proteins and cell-based assays.
  • For one of the roles, we are seeking strong cell-culture skills, including experience engineering cell lines for screening applications using methods such as CRISPR, lentiviral transduction, or transposon-based integration; experience working with membrane proteins is also highly preferred.  
  • Experience designing and building pooled DNA libraries, and using next-generation sequencing to track enrichment in selection campaigns.
  • Familiarity with recombinant protein production, purification, and/or binding assays is an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret complex screening data and write scripts in Python or a similar language; familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or other LLM-based platforms.
  • Applies quantitative reasoning and sound experimental judgment to assess data quality, troubleshoot assays, and guide next steps.
  • Takes ownership of applied biology projects from initial concept through execution, analysis, and delivery.
  • Brings intellectual curiosity to new technical challenges, shares expertise readily, and helps colleagues grow through collaboration and mentorship.
  • High level of cross-functional autonomy and self-motivation. 

Who will love this job: 

  • Biologists who integrate computational insight with experimentation to tackle complex problems.
  • Experimentalists who enjoy making difficult targets, including membrane proteins, tractable for pooled binding screens.
  • Platform builders who value assay robustness, data quality, and interpretable results alongside throughput.

title: Candidate Experience Coordinator, Cambridge, MA
description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 

 

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

 

Your impact 

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do 

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

  • Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.
  • Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.
  • Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.
  • Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

  • Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure  candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

  • Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.
  • Identify & Eradicate Bottlenecks: Proactively flag recurring scheduling challenges or process delays. You won’t just follow the process; you will help evolve it by suggesting improvements and piloting new workflows.

3. Enablement & Strategic Partnership

  • Scaling processes: Utilising AI, you will assist in documenting core processes for TA, creating clear and consistent guides for everything from complex scheduling to offer approval workflows. Additionally, you will ensure effective training for any new coordinators and wider TA members.
  • Champion Interdisciplinary Partnership: You will have opportunities for domain alignment with specific verticals, allowing you to build deeper context on the roles you support and partner closely with Hiring Managers, thereby leveraging diverse skills and perspectives across the business.

Skills and qualifications 

Essential:

  • Exceptional Organisation: Ability to prioritise multiple functions and tasks while maintaining the highest attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience Centric: A strong focus on providing the best possible candidate experience, with the empathy to manage relationships through the entire recruitment lifecycle.
  • Tech & Data Savvy: Experience using online calendar/meeting applications (G-Suite preferred) and a data-driven approach with a strong desire to advocate for clean data.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of keeping stakeholders updated and writing "human-first" correspondence.
  • Global Mindset: Experience scheduling and complex coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Process Mindset: The ability to learn complex systems quickly and a willingness to question "how things are done" to find better solutions.

Nice to have:

  • ATS Expertise: Deep experience with Applicant Tracking Systems, specifically Greenhouse
  • Project Management: Experience leading or contributing to operational projects (e.g., event logistics, data cleanup, survey rollouts).
  • Agency or Search Firm Experience: Experience acting as the main point of contact for external partners.


Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it. 

Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.


Creating an extraordinary company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.


Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment

  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting

This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

title: Business Intelligence Solution Developer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Business Intelligence (BI) Solution Developer serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. 

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas.

description:
Avalere Healthについて
私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。
このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。
私たちは柔軟な働き方を大切にしています。各グローバルチームは、チームやクライアントのニーズに応じて、オフィス勤務または在宅勤務を選択できます。ロンドン、マンチェスター、ワシントンD.C.、ニューヨークの主要拠点に加え、世界各地のオフィスが、必要な時にチームが集まるコラボレーション拠点となっています。在宅勤務の社員にも、交流の機会や必要なリソースを提供しています。
インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。


ポジションについて
Avalere Healthのグローバルマーケティング部門で、クライアント案件の日々の進行を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブを募集します。クライアントパートナーシップ、プロジェクトマネジメント、クリエイティブ、ストラテジーなどのメンバーと連携し、案件が予定どおり、正確かつ円滑に進むよう調整するポジションです。
会議の準備や議事録、進捗・アクション管理、ブリーフ作成の支援、承認状況の確認など、案件運営の土台となる業務を担当します。細かな点まで丁寧に確認し、リスクや課題を早めに共有しながら、自分の担当業務を着実に前へ進めることが求められます。
入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。
 福利厚生・働き方 Avalere Health Japanでは、柔軟な働き方と、社員一人ひとりが能力を発揮できる職場環境を大切にしています。 休暇・福利厚生制度については、日本法人の雇用条件および社内規程に基づいて提供します。 また、グローバルネットワークとの協働、継続的な学習機会、専門性を高めるためのサポートを通じて、社員の成長とキャリア開発を支援します。 応募者の皆さまへ Avalere Healthへ応募される前に、応募者向けプライバシー通知をご確認ください。 応募者向けプライバシー通知を開く

title: Account Manager - Medical
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes

  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What you should have: 

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines

  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts

  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. title: Founding GTM
description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. Role We're looking for a Founding GTM Associate to build the top of our enterprise pipeline, working side by side with our founders and sales team. Our go-to-market runs from open source to enterprise. Developers find and build on our open models, and the companies they work for need production-grade, supported versions for products where latency, privacy and offline operation matter. Your job is to make that path faster and more predictable. This is a hands-on, commercial role with one clear goal: book as many qualified meetings as possible for our sales team. title: Hydrographer/Geophysicist
description: The Role We are the explorers. We are the builders. We are the Wayfinders. Bedrock is mapping the unseen world beneath our oceans and building the systems to do it at scale. We're hiring a Hydrographer/Geophysicist to work with some of the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet. You'll process and analyze multibeam, sidescan, magnetometer, and sub-bottom data from Bedrock field tests and commercial operations, and you'll own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality. When something looks strange in a dataset, you'll be the person asking what it tells us about the vehicle, the survey plan, or the seafloor itself. You will also be in front of customers discussing data quality, interpretation, and deliverables, and teaching them how to read what they're seeing and what it's worth. This is a role for someone who relishes that part of the job. And you'll be on the leading edge of the field. Bedrock is working with major governments around the world on how uncertainty and accuracy should be defined in ocean data- literally helping write the book, the policy, and the guidelines. This is the team revolutionizing how the seafloor gets characterized, and you'd have a say in what the next decade of this field looks like. We are hiring for curiosity, speed of learning, and real excitement about seeing the seafloor in higher fidelity than anyone has seen it before. If you have most of what's below and you're hungry to learn the rest, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Data Processing & Quality First-pass analysis of MBES, SSS, magnetometer, and/or sub-bottom profiler data using commercial software (Qimera, Seaview, SonarWiz, Radex, etc.) Own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality- first pass gets us information, not perfection Spot artifacts and anomalies, and reason about what caused them Work with Bedrock leadership and customers to hold the highest data quality standard in the industry Clients & Education Create data products and write-ups for commercial clients Serve as a primary point of contact for data quality issues, interpretations, and deliverables Teach clients about the unique value of AUV data, and what they can do with it- bring them on the journey rather than handing over a file Explain trade-offs, limitations, and uncertainty clearly, directly, and without defensiveness The Leading Edge Contribute to how uncertainty and accuracy get defined in ocean data-work that feeds into government standards, policy, and guidelines Collaborate with product and engineering on iterative improvements to the vehicle and to survey planning Help build the processing workflows that let all of this scale Who You Are You're a curious, fast-learning data person who wants to be on the vanguard of ocean data, and who would rather be in the conversation with the customer than behind it. Experience Experience processing and reporting on at least two of: MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler, using commercial software Comfort with ArcGIS, QGIS, and/or AutoCAD Experience writing data reports for commercial clients Attention to detail- you find the artifact nobody else saw Nice to Have Experience across all four relevant sensor types (MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler) Light coding (Python/SQL) Offshore experience (ship or AUV ops) Certified Hydrographer, Cat A or Cat B; Licensed Surveyor Experience across defense (mine countermeasures, unexploded ordnance), energy (oil & gas, offshore wind), and/or environmental survey How You Operate You learn fast, and you ask good questions when you are uncertain You treat processing as a problem-solving activity, not a checkbox exercise Iterative by instinct, you improve the data and the workflow with every pass Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change You use tools and AI to increase speed, accuracy, and leverage You are comfortable, clear, and collaborative in front of a customer What You Care About The idea of seeing the seafloor in a way no one has seen it before excites you You take pride in craft, clarity, and accuracy You have some connection to the ocean, professional, academic, or personal and you are excited to be around people who dive, sail, build, and explore offshore Not a Fit If... You want the data perfect on the first pass-iterative improvement is our way You are uncomfortable with uncertainty or with rapid changes in priorities You are not interested in learning new tools and approaches You do not want to interface directly with clients, or you see customer education as a distraction from the real work You are looking for predictable hours and firm boundaries around when the work happens. This job will require some nights and weekends around survey campaigns. Estimated compensation for this position is $95,000- $130,000 annually plus equity. Actual salary offered will be based on qualifications, experience, and location (SF and NY being at the high end of the band). If you want to work on the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet and help decide what comes next in this field, we should talk.

title: Account Manager - SMB
description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Role Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed. This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement. As an Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad. Our European base is growing quickly, and this role is for someone who can work with customers in German, French or Spanish as well as English. title: PLOS One Public Health and Epidemiology Associate Editor- 12 Month FTC
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA. 

This is a 12 month FTC

In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America.

 

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all. The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals.  This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries.
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld.
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments.
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio.
  • Handle publication ethics queries.
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community.
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry.
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy.
  • Able to set priorities and work independently.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject area required. A PHD, MD or similiar level is preferred. 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is $67,000 to $73,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS: 

 

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

 

 

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Data Science Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or UK remote | 💰 £100,000 to £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Data  

 

⭐ About Data at Monzo

Data is at the heart of how we make decisions and build products at Monzo. Our Data teams bring together Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning, working closely with Product, Engineering and other teams across the business.

Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy.

As a Data Science Manager, you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders.

🔑 You'll play a key role by...

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products.

You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals.
  • Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work.
  • Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction.
  • Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities.
  • Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning.
  • Help connect Data Science work to measurable customer, product and commercial outcomes.
  • Work with Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning and other Data disciplines to ensure teams have the data, tooling and infrastructure they need.
  • Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work.

🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...

  • What we're doing at Monzo excites you!

title: Developer Support Engineer (London)
description: About the company Braintrust is the agent observability platform. About the Role At Braintrust, surprisingly good developer support is one of our most important strategic advantages. Our customers are developers building LLM-powered applications, and they move fast. We win by helping them move faster. We’re looking for Developer Support Engineers — both mid-level and senior — who are obsessed with helping developers overcome challenging technical blockers to achieve their goals. You’ll troubleshoot issues, identify workarounds, ship fixes, and document your findings to help future developers move faster. This role blends technical problem solving, developer empathy, and tight collaboration with Engineering, Solutions, and Product. If you love solving complex problems, explaining technical concepts clearly, and making developers’ lives easier, we’d love to talk with you. This role will be remote based in London. What You’ll Do Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve API and SDK use issues alongside customers codebases (Python or TypeScript). Reproduce customer-reported bugs, identify likely causes in our codebase, and collaborate with Engineering to resolve them. Own support communications with developers using Braintrust — primarily via Slack and email — and build trust through clear, technical, and empathetic communication. Write and maintain knowledge base documentation that turns unknowns into knowns, unblocking future developers. Identify opportunities to improve the developer experience, including tools, documentation, and support workflows. Write scripts, fix bugs, and contribute to internal tooling that enhances the support process. Capture and relay customer feedback to Product and Engineering, helping shape roadmap priorities. Participate in on-call rotations, responding to critical customer issues or providing coverage during local holidays. Provide technical mentorship to cross functional peers and guide support processes and escalation handling. Develop and champion opinionated stances on improving developer experience and product reliability. What we're looking for Experience supporting developer-facing products as a Software Engineer, Customer Engineer, Developer Success Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or similar customer facing technical role. Can write, debug, and reason through Python and/or TypeScript codebases. Are comfortable learning and reasoning about APIs, SDKs, and developer tools quickly. Take personal ownership of technical problems and follow through until customers are unblocked. Communicate clearly, empathetically, and effectively — especially when explaining complex or confusing issues. Are insatiably curious about use cases for LLMs and excited to support tools that make AI more measurable, reliable, and trustworthy. Bonus Points For Experience supporting developer tools, ML infrastructure, or observability platforms. Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs. Comfort working with datasets, evaluation metrics, or prompt engineering. Experience contributing to support tooling, documentation, or product-led growth initiatives. Have been a senior technical team member or tech lead in a high-growth environment, taking ownership of ambiguous technical scenarios. Have submitted PRs to production codebases to fix customer-impacting issues in backend services, SDKs, or infrastructure. Hold cloud certifications or equivalent experience troubleshooting containerized environments (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes). Why join Braintrust Build a culture of care, learning, and mutual support together Solve challenging, unknown technical issues faced by developers Pave the way for future developers and peers to benefit from your experience Benefits include Medical, dental, and vision insurance Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages Flexible time off Competitive salary and equity Wifi & cellphone stipend Equal opportunity Braintrust is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. title: Delivery Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Delivery Engineering team The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that) – we specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do. The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries. What you’ll be doing Own end-to-end model delivery on hx, from scoping and build through to testing, iteration, and customer delivery. Build and maintain production-grade Python models, applying modern engineering and modelling practices. Work directly with customer actuarial teams and internal stakeholders to solve complex, ambiguous modelling and coding problems. Raise quality across the team through code review, testing, and contributions to best-practice model development guidance. Support and mentor junior model developers through pairing, feedback, and day-to-day delivery support. Continuously look for ways to improve our model development standards, tooling, and ways of working. What you’ll need to have done Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments. Applied predictive modelling or advanced analytics in real-world settings (insurance or reinsurance exposure is a bonus, not a requirement). Taken ownership of ambiguous problems, creating structure and driving them through to high-quality outcomes. Worked directly with non-technical stakeholders or customers, translating requirements into robust technical solutions. Operated effectively in a high-trust, high-accountability environment, proactively driving your own development and learning. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno . Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
 
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
 
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. Our Business Consulting team is focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program (BCDP).
 
We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early. You will collaborate with experienced team members on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions.  
 
In our structured 20 month program, we equip you with the resources to develop the core consulting skills, deep domain expertise, and leadership foundation for long-term career success at Veeva.
 
BCDP spans five core practice areas: Analytics, Commercial, Content, R&D, and Quality. As an Associate Consultant you will align to one of those practices, allowing you to build targeted industry expertise. You will be asked to choose your preferred practice in the application process.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context Germany is one of Europe's largest healthcare markets, and its hospitals face the same pressure we solve in France: rising administrative load, staff shortages and revenue lost to incomplete coding. As Germany GTM Lead, you are our first hire in the country. You will report directly to Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, and work closely with Chris, our CTO, and the product team in Paris. You will own everything from the first prospecting call to the first signed contracts, shape the local product and build the German team from zero. Location: 2 to 3 months of onboarding in Paris, then based in Germany with regular trips to Paris. Office in Munich or Berlin. Team: none at first. Around 5 people in H1 2027, around 12 by the end of 2027. Who you are A builder who wants to open a market, not run one. You are open to about 3 months of regular trips to Paris, with a long-term base in Germany. Bonus: you know the German healthcare system, or you have already launched a business. Bonus: you have hired and managed a team, or worked on M&A or the integration of an acquired team. Our values Play to Win: we are not here just to participate, ship something “good enough”, or enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring deeply about outcomes, moving fast and being willing to put in the intensity required when it matters. High Trust, High Standards: trust is our default. If you joined us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with responsibility. The more freedom we give, the higher the standard we expect. Low Ego, Hands-On: no one at Parallel is above doing the work. Titles, seniority and past achievements don't exempt anyone from getting their hands dirty. Everyone should be willing to step into the arena when needed. Leadership means taking responsibility, not creating distance from execution. Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: we are extremely serious about our mission. We don't need to be extremely serious about ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laugh, celebrate and bring energy to the people around them. High standards and good vibes are not opposites. We want both.
